data.action: 扛着勘探镐，用毛巾擦汗
data.description: 【森蚺 · 荒地勘探】烈日炎炎的萨贡雨林矿石勘探现场，森蚺单手扛着沉重的合金勘探镐，脖子上挂着毛巾擦拭着大颗滑落的汗水。她古铜色健美的肌肤在阳光下泛着健康的光泽——「地底下埋藏着最优质的高强度合金矿石！只要把它们挖出来，我们就能建造更大更强的机甲了！」
data.promptProse: At the humid rainforest mineral site, Eunectes carries a heavy pickaxe over one shoulder and wipes her brow with the neck towel. Open khaki utility shirt, olive sports top, cargo trousers, climbing harness and explorer boots retain the expedition outfit. The medium-wide view includes muddy excavation ground surrounded by dense foliage. Harsh afternoon sun illuminates metal carabiners and towel edges, leaving deep leaf shadows and darker wet soil beneath the tools.
data.title: 森蚺 · 荒地勘探
